about: [C4] The way out of the diner after the last blow (docs/story/briefs/C4_FIGHT.md §4), by real input from ?start=fight.ko: the street door is barred (walked into, it rattles: 'Barred.'), the objective says where ('See to him.'); the other way out, over the sill of the bay he went through (SPACE), onto the pavement beside him; the search, the matchbook, Ames's card, the line where it sends me, the still, chapter III. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/fight_out.json

steps.label: [C4] after the last blow: the street door barred; the line says where: See to him.

steps.name: the door tried: it rattles on its bar

steps.look: (() => { const C = N.controller; const want = Math.atan2(-(-10.4 - G.eye.x), -(0.6 - G.eye.z)); const dy = Math.atan2(Math.sin(want - C.yaw), Math.cos(want - C.yaw)); return [Math.round(-dy / C.sensitivity), Math.round(-(-0.1 - C.pitch) / C.sensitivity)]; })()

steps.label: [C4] walked into, the barred door rattles and holds (I stay inside)

steps.name: out over the sill of the broken bay

steps.walk: (() => { const w = G.scenes.ctx.flags.window || 'B4', bz = { B2: 5.0, B4: -3.8 }[w], L = G.scenes.ctx.flags.landing; const zc = Math.max(bz - 1.25, Math.min(bz + 1.25, L.z + (L.z >= bz ? -1.3 : 1.3))); return [[-12.4, 0.6], [-12.0, zc], [-11.15, zc]]; })()

steps.look: (() => { const C = N.controller; const want = Math.atan2(-(-10.4 - G.eye.x), 0); const dy = Math.atan2(Math.sin(want - C.yaw), Math.cos(want - C.yaw)); return [Math.round(-dy / C.sensitivity), Math.round(-(-0.45 - C.pitch) / C.sensitivity)]; })()

steps.label: [C4] over the sill onto the pavement beside him (not through the wall, not through the door)
